name: flagtriv
description: Addictive flag guessing game with daily challenges and achievements

scripts.build:web: rm -rf www && mkdir -p www && cp -r index.html style.css script.js countries.json js images flags sounds www/ 2>/dev/null || cp -r index.html style.css script.js countries.json js images flags www/ && sed -i '' '/<div id="app-footer"/,/<\/div>/d' www/index.html 2>/dev/null || sed -i '/<div id="app-footer"/,/<\/div>/d' www/index.html
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:ios: npm run build && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.cap:android: npm run build && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
